caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden object that resembles a roundel or medallion, featuring a prominent, raised letter "S" in the center. The main body of the object is circular with scalloped edges. The letter "S" and the border are colored in a muted, weathered gold hue, while the background around the "S" is shaded with tones of pink and red. There are accents of grey and brown, particularly in the wooden portions, suggesting aging and texture. The right side of the object has an irregular, elongated extension that tapers off and appears chipped or broken, revealing more brown wood coloration. The object is isolated on a plain, off-white background with no other elements present. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a signature that reads "Katherine Merrill."
title: Insignia Letter "S"
